question.text: The coordinate axes is rotated and shifted in such a way that the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>IV</mi><mi>th</mi></msup></math> quadrant direction of line <math><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>35</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> becomes the new positive <math><mi>x</mi></math>-axis direction and the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></msup></math> quadrant direction of line <math><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> becomes the new positive <math><mi>y</mi></math>-axis direction. If origin as per old coordinate system is <math><mi>O</mi><mo>,</mo></math> then according to the new coordinate system, the coordinates of <math><mi>O</mi></math> are

solution.text:
Distance of 0,0 from lines 4x+3y-35=0 (new x -axis) and 3x-4y+5=0 (new y -axis) are 7 units and 1 unit respectively.
Since, according to the new coordinate system O lies in IVth quadrant, hence the new coordinates of O are 1,-7
